build_event_processor_from_loader: build an EventProcessor from a ScenarioLoader to run a Gaia2 scenario simulation
build_turn_triggers: build turn trigger ConditionCheck events at turn boundaries for multi-turn Gaia2 scenarios
run_tick_loop: run the EventProcessor tick loop to drain scheduled events and return pending ENV actions
collect_turn_agent_events: collect agent events for a specific turn index to evaluate with a judge
assign_turn_indices: assign turn indices to scenario events using BFS over the dependency DAG
